status: PREREGISTERED AND COMPOSABLE — NOT AUTHORIZED TO FLY. No owner GO exists for this cell and none is claimed. OBS-E1 remains REJECTED.
purpose: The PERSON harm decomposition (docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-obs-e1-person-harm-decomposition-v1.md) charged 78.7 % of OBS-E1's 61 excess PERSON errors to units under ten seconds, found the damage on BOTH edges of a unit rather than only the tail side, and measured that the cut goes through a multi-word name once in 656 — the shape of a MISSING-CONTEXT failure, not of a truncate-at-the-tail one. This cell gives the context back: the same 5,122 speaker-turn units, each delivered as [left context | the turn | right context], with the stitched text still the turn's own.

population.unit_plan_predecessor: docs/receipts/obs/e21-speaker-turn-units-v2.json (SAEA-E21-MF-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V2), whose 5,122 turns this plan inherits unchanged, asserted field by field by the builder
population.selection: no draw: the whole frozen earnings21-original discovery split, the comparator's own population, already exposed many times over.
population.estimand: the pooled delta, comparator minus cell, of ConEC-mirror PERSON entity WER and of corpus WER, over all 44 calls.
population.strata: unit duration (< 3 / 3-5 / 5-10 / 10-30 / 30-60 / >= 60 s, the decomposition's own ladder), realized context seconds per unit, end cut (pause / turn-boundary / forced-cap-split / call-end), ends-mid-speech, speaker change from the previous unit, boundary ownership rule (anchor / anchor-short / proportional / no-overlap), and the release's own sector and sample rate.

cells.obs: the v3 plan's speaker-turn units, each delivered with a nominal 5.0 s context margin per side (10.0 s floor on the delivered cut, 90.0 s ceiling, clamped to the call); no VAD trim, no rolling tail, no preprocessing; 2.0 s digital silence tail on the delivered bytes only
cells.text_ownership: saea-obs-context-ownership-v1 — the stitched hypothesis is each unit's own turn, resolved on the overlap both neighbours received
cells.serving_geometry: -c 36864 -np 6, 6,144 tokens per slot, GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU
cells.audio_path: raw audio through the bf16 mmproj on the GPU; no feature cache, no CPU packet preprocessing, no MP3 re-decode

This is load-bearing: the boundary-marker protocol was REJECTED because it would have changed the instruction and made the contrast against OBS-E1 two-factor.

pairing.statistic: analysis.paired.resampled_statistic on the pooled ratio sum(numerator)/sum(denominator) over the resampled call ids
pairing.power_limitation: n = 44 clusters is BELOW the program's n >= 400 rule for a paired effectiveness claim. This cell reports an interval and a direction and makes NO paper-facing effectiveness claim.
pairing.secondary_read: preregistered and labelled: charging both arms' alignment operations to the sealed 90-second window grid by REFERENCE index, as OBS-E1's own verdict did. It buys a saves/harms/ties count and the per-window strata, NOT power.

decision.delta_convention: comparator minus cell, in points; positive = the cell is better

rule.admitted: CI90 LB(delta PERSON entity WER) > 0 AND CI90 LB(delta corpus WER) > 0
rule.non_inferior_and_kept: CI90 LB(delta PERSON entity WER) > -0.25009 AND CI90 LB(delta corpus WER) > 0
rule.no_effect: neither, and CI90 on both deltas contains 0
rule.harm: CI90 UB(delta PERSON) < -0.25009 or CI90 UB(delta corpus WER) < 0, with the failing half named and the gap decomposed per stratum and per call

decision.non_inferiority_margin_basis: 0.25009 points is the PERSON half-width the study's OWN null replicate measured (SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1, docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-own-null-replicate-v1-verdict.md: PERSON delta +0.00000, CI90 [-0.24338, +0.25680], max |bound| 0.25009). It is this carrier's own measured noise floor, not an imported number, and it is the margin OBS-E1's harm was 8.4 half-widths outside of.
decision.corpus_wer_has_no_margin_here: OBS-E1 BOUGHT +1.0487 corpus-WER points. A successor that gives that back is not a repair, so the corpus leg is a strict improvement over the comparator (LB > 0), not a non-inferiority.

stop_and_report_conditions.stitch_fallback_rate: proportional + clamped boundaries > 5.0 % of the 5,078 boundaries. The model-free proof measured 0.02 % under a same-arm overlap and 2.9 % under the most adversarial pairing available (an independent decode of the same audio as context), so this fires only if reality is WORSE than that ceiling.
stop_and_report_conditions.stitched_corpus_word_count: outside +/- 15 % of OBS-E1's sealed 368,011 words. A stitch that ate or duplicated the transcript would show here before any metric is read.
stop_and_report_conditions.consequence: the run is reported, NOT scored as clean, and the verdict names the failing guard. This is the same discipline obs_slice_skip_max already applies to skipped audio.

decision.falsifier_before_any_score: for every call, cutting each delivered slice back to its own TURN sub-range (the plan's own context_left/right offsets), dropping the 2.0-second tail, and concatenating those must reproduce that call's sealed saea-diarization-v1 audio_sha256. This holds if and only if the turns still tile, the context bounds are exactly where the plan says, and every cut is byte-exact against the sealed slices. A disagreement stops the cell before it is scored.
decision.claim_surface: Discovery data. No superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim, and no paper-facing effectiveness claim at all. No knob tuned on the evaluation ten: the context rule's three numbers were fixed model-free before any score existed, and the margin ladder in the stitch proof was run for the STITCH's correctness, never for a metric.

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: the unit count plus 10 % retry headroom: ceil(5,122 x 1.10) = 5,635 (513 calls of headroom for obs_slice_retry_max=1). Identical to OBS-E1's, because the contact count is identical.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 201,558.352 s delivered (141,345.853 cut + 49,968.499 context + 5,122 x 2.0 s of tail) x 1.10 retry headroom = 221,714.187, rounded up to 222,000.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: BRACKETED by the model the OBS-E1 verdict's section 7 established for this carrier and geometry: on this hardware the cost tracks ENCODED SECONDS, not requests — OBS-E1's realized 1.0657 GPU-h landed 2 % above the audio-proportional floor while the contact-proportional ceiling over-predicted by 2.9x. Audio-proportional: 1.0657 x 201,558.352 / 151,589.853 = 1.417 GPU-h. Contact-proportional: 1.0657 x 5,122 / 5,122 = 1.066 GPU-h — the contact model predicts NO increase at all, because the contacts do not move, which is exactly why the audio model is the binding one here. 2.0 planned is a 1.41x margin on the audio bracket; the projection is re-measured on the smoke and the flight STOPS and reports if the measured rate projects past the registered ceiling.
execution_plan_basis.projected_wall_minutes: 99.4 x 201,558.352 / 151,589.853 = 132 minutes at the same realized throughput.
execution_plan_basis.projected_prompt_tokens: 2,255,812 x 201,558.352 / 151,589.853 = about 3.00 M, against OBS-E1's 2.26 M. The WORST single request does not move: the delivered cut is capped at 90 s.
execution_plan_basis.budget_is_run_cumulative: core/model/adapter.py enforces planned_model_calls and planned_speech_audio_seconds across ALL attempts of a run id, so a partially spent attempt cannot be re-run under this id and the one permitted recovery would take a fresh run id and a fresh exposure row.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values. This cell's row does not exist yet and must be registered, with consumed = no, before the first contact.
